description: The fleet's shared Renovate preset (danhon/reverse-proxy#7). Each repo's renovate.json extends github>danhon/renovate-config.
Public so public repos can extend it too. How it fits the patch policy: reverse-proxy docs-site/docs/host/patching.md, 'Renovate'; rules IMG-1 and IMG-2 on its conventions page.

packageRules.description: The monthly feature batch: every non-major update in one PR, opened early on the 1st, before the patch-monthly reminder at 09:00
IMG-1: an image a compose file runs as it comes is pinned to version@digest
IMG-1: a Dockerfile FROM keeps a version tag without a digest, so patch-rebuild picks up the base image's security fixes within 7 or 30 days
A new Python or Node minor in a FROM is a runtime upgrade (3.12 to 3.13), not a patch: its own PR, still monthly
IMG-2: build tools wait two weeks
Traefik and Authelia (reverse-proxy#4): their own PR as soon as a release is 3 days old, never grouped or automerged. Merging changes the pin; patch-edge-update.py deploys it
prBodyNotes: **Edge image: don't `docker compose up` this.** After merging, on ubuntuplex in a quiet hour: `git -C ~/dev/reverse-proxy pull`, then `scripts/patch-edge-update.py {{#if (equals depName 'traefik')}}traefik{{else}}authelia{{/if}}`, which probes the routes and rolls back by itself. If it rolls back, revert this PR's commit. Runbook: docs-site/docs/host/patching.md.
